Name: Adventurer Pets HD
Overview:
There once was a notorious gambler named Johnny Five Aces, who hid a treasure somewhere. There is a map to this treasure, but it has been split into six pieces, and only one who has all six pieces can find the treasure. Enter the Adventurer Pets, four anthropomorphic pets who all want the treasure for themselves, and will do whatever they can to collect all the pieces of the map.

Adventurer Pets is a multiplayer battle platform game. Up to four players battle on each stage, using items like bombs and shields to kill opponents or protect themselves, with the goal of having the most treasure at the end of the game. There is also a single-player adventure mode where the player must collect the treasure on each stage with a limited number of lives, and a time-attack mode where the player has infinite lives but dying will incur a time penalty.
